@G = external global i8
@G.1 = external global <8 x i8>
@G.2 = external global i64

define <2 x b128> @test_bitinsert_v2ptr_b128(<2 x b128> %base, <2 x ptr> %val) {
  %A5 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 poison, ptr %A5, align 4
  %LGV3 = load i64, ptr @G.2, align 4
  %A = alloca <8 x i8>, align 8
  %L = load i64, ptr %A, align 4
  store <8 x i8> poison, ptr %A, align 8
  %LGV1 = load <8 x i8>, ptr @G.1, align 8
  %B2 = lshr <8 x i8> splat (i8 42), %LGV1
  %B4 = udiv i64 %L, %LGV3
  %LGV = load i8, ptr @G, align 1
  %B = add i8 %LGV, 1
  %result = bitinsert <2 x b128> %base, <2 x ptr> %val, <2 x i32> splat (i32 32)
  store i8 %B, ptr @G, align 1
  store <8 x i8> %B2, ptr %A, align 8
  store i64 %B4, ptr %A5, align 4
  ret <2 x b128> %result
}

@G.3 = external global float

declare void @foo(ptr)

declare dso_local i32 @__gxx_personality_v0(...)

define void @caller(ptr %p) personality ptr @__gxx_personality_v0 {
entry:
  %0 = icmp eq ptr %p, null
  %G = getelementptr half, ptr %p, i128 42
  br i1 %0, label %bb1, label %bb2

bb1:                                              ; preds = %entry
  invoke void @foo(ptr %p)
          to label %end1 unwind label %lpad

bb2:                                              ; preds = %entry
  invoke void %G(ptr %p)
          to label %end2 unwind label %lpad

lpad:                                             ; preds = %bb2, %bb1
  %1 = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          cleanup
  call void @callee(ptr %p)
  resume { ptr, i32 } %1

end1:                                             ; preds = %bb1
  ret void

end2:                                             ; preds = %bb2
  %E = extractelement <4 x float> splat (float +qnan), i1 %0
  store float %E, ptr @G.3, align 4
  ret void
}

declare hidden void @callee(ptr)
